stages.title: How a build *runs*
stages.intro: One project manager from survey to handover, and a written update every week.

items.name: Survey
items.line: Measured, drawn and priced before anything starts.
about: We measure the house, read your architect's drawings and walk the job with you. Then we price it line by line, and you see every line.
Before anything is signed you have a fixed price and a programme for your house, week by week.

items.name: Structure
items.line: Foundations, steel and the dig, checked at every stage.
about: The groundworks, the footings and the slab, then the steel and the walls. Building control inspects at each stage, and so does your project manager.
This is the noisy part. We agree the hours with you and your neighbours before it starts.

items.name: Envelope
items.line: Roof, walls and glass. Dry from here.
about: The roof goes on, the glazing goes in and the house is weathertight. From here the work moves inside, and the garden starts to come back.

items.name: Finish
items.line: Plaster, joinery and stone, then the snagging walk together.
about: First fix, plaster, then the joinery, stone and paint. The last two weeks are for the details nobody else would notice.
At handover we walk every room with you and write down anything that isn't right. Then we put it right.

build3d.title: The build, *stage by stage*
build3d.intro: The same extension from the survey to the day we hand you the keys. Tap a stage.

howWeBuild.title: How we *build*
howWeBuild.intro: Four stages, one project manager, a written update every Friday.

sections.title: The *contract*
text: We build on a fixed-price contract with a programme attached. If you change something, we price the change in writing before we do it.

sections.title: How you *pay*
text: In stages, as each one is finished and you have seen it. Never more than the work done so far.
We never change our bank details by email. Call us before paying if anything looks different.

sections.title: After *handover*
text: A twelve-month defects period, and a visit at six months to check the house has settled.

sections.title: Living at home *during the work*
text: Most of our clients stay in. We seal off the work, keep a kitchen running where we can, and tell you a week ahead about the noisy days and the ones when the water or power will be off.

items.scope: A rear extension and a new kitchen.
